name: Yahoo Panoptes
what_it_is: A Python-based network telemetry ecosystem implementing discovery, enrichment, and polling of network devices at global scale. It provides a plugin-driven, horizontally scalable architecture for collecting SNMP and other metrics, transforming them, and forwarding to time-series databases.
components: Redis (enrichment cache, secrets store, resource state)
measurement: Gauge metrics (counters converted to rates by polling agent)
Interface metrics group (bits_in, bits_out, packets_in, packets_out)
Millisecond-resolution Unix epoch timestamps per metric
Metrics grouped by metrics_group_type with dimensions (tags)
configuration: panoptes.ini: main INI-style config; sections for main, log, redis, kafka, zookeeper, discovery, polling, enrichment
sites: comma-delimited list of physical/logical datacenter names
Redis namespaces: panoptes (default), metrics, resources, secrets
SNMP community string stored in Redis: SET panoptes:secrets:snmp_community_string:<site> <string>
Plugin config files use .panoptes-plugin extension; define execute_frequency, resource_filter DSL, plugin module path
Resource filter DSL (SQL subset): =, !=, LIKE, AND, OR, NOT, IN operators over resource fields and metadata
localhost.json: JSON file listing resources for discovery when no external CMDB is available
SNMP_SITE env var (default: local) and SNMP_COMM_STRING env var (default: public) for Docker container
--max-tasks-per-child 10 on polling worker to limit memory growth
fault_injection: snmpd included in Docker image as a local SNMP polling target (localhost)
Plugin agent enforces distributed lock per plugin+resource pair via Zookeeper to prevent duplicate polling
Plugin agent skips execution if last run was less than execute_frequency seconds ago (rate limiting / anti-DOS)
No explicit fault injection framework; snmpd on localhost serves as controllable test target
modes: Single-node (Docker container): all services packed into one container with daemontools supervision
Distributed/clustered: separate hosts for schedulers, agents, Redis, Kafka, Zookeeper, InfluxDB
Plugin types: Discovery (enumerate resources), Enrichment (metadata collection, cached in Redis), Polling (metric collection)
Counter-to-gauge transformation mode in polling agent (applied before Kafka publish)
constraints: Python 3.6 required (Docker image); original codebase documented as Python 2.7 only — versions diverge
Kafka version hard dependency: tested with 0.10.2.0 (downloaded from ASF archives during build)
Redis tested with 3.0.7; Zookeeper tested with 3.4.5
Parenthetical grouping not supported in resource filter DSL: 'NOT (A OR B)' is invalid
Enrichment dimension values must be strings only
Plugin code runs in shared process with full OS permissions of the panoptes user — no sandboxing
Resource filter DSL does not support nested parentheses grouping
Docker container is single-node only; not suitable for production deployment
5-minute delay before first metrics appear in Docker container
Grafana dashboard changes do not persist across container restarts
docker_services: Ubuntu 18.04 base with Python 3.6, open-jdk 8, Redis, Zookeeper, Kafka, InfluxDB, Grafana, snmpd, daemontools
No docker-compose.yml found in main repo or panoptes_docker repo; single docker run command is the official method
notable_absences: No docker-compose.yml: official deployment is a single monolithic docker run command, not a compose stack
No built-in fault injection or chaos tooling beyond snmpd as test target
No TLS/auth on SNMP by default (SNMPv2c community string only; SNMPv3 not mentioned)
No REST API for resource or metric queries; data access is through Redis (enrichments) and InfluxDB (metrics) directly
No Prometheus or OpenMetrics output format; InfluxDB is the only shipped consumer sink
No streaming/push support from devices; polling is strictly pull-based
